name: IBPS CRP PO/MT — Probationary Officer / Management Trainee
sourceLabel: IBPS — Guidelines for scanning & uploading photograph and signature (CRP PO/MT 2025)
sourceNote: Specifications read directly from the official IBPS registration-portal guidelines PDF: photograph 200 × 230 px, 20–50 KB; signature 140 × 60 px, 10–20 KB; JPG/JPEG.

photo.label: Passport-style photograph
notes: Recent passport-style colour photograph on a light, preferably white background.
Face square to the camera; no caps, hats or dark glasses.
200 × 230 px is the authority's preferred pixel size.

signature.label: Signature
notes: Signed on white paper with a black ink pen.
Signature must be by the applicant, not a third party.
140 × 60 px is the authority's preferred pixel size.

organization: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee — GATE 2025
name: GATE 2025 — Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering
sourceLabel: GATE 2025 — Photograph and Signature requirements (official organising institute page)
sourceNote: Official GATE 2025 page: photo 3.5 × 4.5 cm, 200 × 260 px minimum to 530 × 690 px maximum, 5 KB–1 MB; signature 250 × 80 px minimum to 580 × 180 px maximum, 3 KB–1 MB; JPEG/JPG only.

photo.label: Passport photograph
notes: Passport size: 3.5 cm width × 4.5 cm height; face covers 60–70% of the frame.
Plain white background; frontal face; no caps, hats or sunglasses.
Aspect ratio must be between 0.66 and 0.89 (width ÷ height).

signature.label: Signature
notes: Black or dark blue ink only.
Signature covers 70–80% of the cropped area.
Aspect ratio (width ÷ height) between 2.75 and 3.75.

name: UPSC Civil Services Examination — Online Application
sourceLabel: UPSC — Instructions for uploading the photo & signature (official application portal)
sourceNote: Official UPSC instructions: photograph JPG, 20–200 KB, face must cover at least 75% of the image; triple signature JPG, 20–100 KB, image width 350–500 px. UPSC does not prescribe fixed photo pixel dimensions.

photo.label: Passport photograph
notes: JPG format, file name 'photo', 20–200 KB.
Face must cover at least 75% (3/4) of the photograph.
Plain white background, frontal view, both ears visible. No cap, mask or spectacles.

signature.label: Triple signature
notes: Sign three times vertically, one below the other, on plain white paper in black ink.
Scan all three signatures into one image; JPG format, file name 'signature'.
20–100 KB; image width 350–500 px.

name: NEET (UG) 2025 — Information Bulletin
sourceNote: Official NEET (UG) 2025 Information Bulletin: passport photograph 10–200 KB, signature 10–50 KB, JPG/JPEG. The bulletin does not state pixel dimensions; crop aspect is therefore free.

photo.label: Passport photograph
notes: Recent colour passport-size photograph taken after 1 January 2025.
80% face visible, including ears, against a white background.
10–200 KB, JPG/JPEG. Pixel dimensions are not fixed by NTA.

signature.label: Signature
notes: Scanned signature, clearly legible, JPG/JPEG.
10–50 KB. Pixel dimensions are not fixed by NTA.
